name: shape
description: Shape of a vector layer, as in Moho: a fill and a stroke over curves of its layer. It has no transform of its own; it moves with the points of its curves. With several curves, the inner ones cut holes (fillRule evenodd). Shapes draw in their order in the layer: the last one on top. When creating it you can pass "d" (an SVG path, any number of subpaths) and its points and curves are added to the layer. Or "at": [x, y] (in the layer's coordinates): it fills the region there, the smallest closed curve around the point with the closed curves inside it as holes (the editor's Fill, Stroke and Both).
help: Fill and stroke over curves of its vector layer. It moves with the points of its curves.

curves.help: Curves of the layer this shape fills and strokes. Inner curves cut holes.
curves.description: Ids of curves of its vector layer. The fill covers the area they enclose (an open curve closes with a straight line for the fill); with several, the inner ones cut holes according to fillRule. The stroke follows every curve.

loops.help: Regions bounded by segments of welded curves: point ids around each one.
loops.description: Regions bounded by segments of curves welded at their points, as Moho's Paint Bucket fills them: each loop is the list of point ids around a region, and between two consecutive points (and from the last back to the first) it follows the curve that joins them there, with its tangents. A lens of two arcs welded at both ends is [["a", "b"]]. When several curves join the same two points, an entry { "p": "b", "via": "curve_id" } names the one to follow from the previous point. Loops add to curves: the inner ones cut holes too (fillRule). They follow their curves in poses and keyframes.

fillRule.help: How curves inside other curves fill: evenodd cuts holes; nonzero fills them unless they turn the other way.
fillRule.description: evenodd: a curve inside another cuts a hole. nonzero: it only cuts a hole if it turns in the opposite direction.

style.help: Shared style. Appearance properties the shape does not set itself come from it.
style.description: Shared style. Appearance properties the shape does not set itself are taken from it.

fill.help: Fill color. Empty = no fill (a line).
fill.description: Fill color. null = no fill (only the stroke: a line).

fillGradient.help: Fill gradient (a linear or radial gradient). When set, it replaces fill.
fillGradient.description: Fill gradient (id of a linear_gradient or radial_gradient), from 0 to 1 over the shape's box. When set, it replaces fill.

visible.help: When off, the shape is not drawn.
visible.description: If false, the shape is not drawn.
